image_description: A small mud turtle being held in a person's hand. The turtle has a dark brown, high-domed carapace with visible keels. Its head is relatively large with a pointed snout and small lateral eyes. The skin appears grey-brown with a scaly texture. Short, stout limbs with webbed feet and claws are visible. The plastron is partially visible and appears yellowish. The turtle is not fully retracted into its shell.
